title: Annotatio V §.XII open: Author lashes four Lutheran testimonia vs Oral-fundamentality
pass_a_gloss: §. XII. At length the most noble Author in four paragraphs so lashes the four Lutheran Testimonies, insofar as from them I had built: that Oral Eating in no way touches the Foundation of Faith.
pass_b_english: §.XII: the Author spends four paragraphs attacking the four Lutheran testimonies Strimesius used.
Those testimonies had shown Oral Eating does not touch the foundation of faith.
source_text: §. XII. Tandem Nobilissimus Autor quatuor paragraphis, Testimonia Lutheranorum quatuor, in tantum lacessat, in quantum ex iis adstruxeram: Oralem Manducationem, Fidei Fundamentum neutiquam attingere.

lemmas.gloss: in no way touch the Foundation of Faith
